verdict.rationale: Meilisearch docs state that once you configure an embedder, it automatically generates vector embeddings for every document, so you don't compute or manage embeddings yourself. These embeddings feed the documented hybrid and semantic search, and the product stores documents and embeddings behind a single API. missing for 10: explicit documentation that query text is auto-vectorized at search time, details on which built-in or managed embedder providers are supported, independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedder workflow.
